test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is closest in meaning to the underlined idiom/phrase in the given sentence.

My room is always __spick and span__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Neat and tidy. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **"spick and span"** is **neat and tidy.**
 
• **Spick and span:** something which is spotlessly clean. 
 
 
• **Example: ***She keeps her room spick and span.*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• The idiom "spick and span" was adopted in the English language in the 1300s.
 
• It is taken from the **Dutch expression "spiksplinternieuw"** which means fresh timbers of a newly built shop. 
 
• This Dutch expression was converted into the English language that we use now. *​*
